content:
为[Farmer's Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-delight)添加了更多适用于[暮色森林](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest)的切菜板配方

- 支持所有木材类型的树皮剥离与回收
- 增加可从花卉中提取的染料

![木材切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DiojkUaV/images/678e6b20992e1efaf0e67e938e350f90fe9c6e89.png) ![花卉切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DiojkUaV/images/31b7e706d5f81a264a876b153b1a88f1d80fd436.png)
